title: Transit
description: The city's buses (M2.9 step 2, D118): a route along every arterial, its stops, how often a bus comes and how fast it goes, and the fare. The figures trace to CALIBRATION.md.

fare.description: In cents: one ride, transfers included within the transfer window.

dayCap.description: In cents: the most fares cost in a day; rides past it are free.

transfer.description: Minutes after boarding in which a second bus is free.

stops.description: Metres between stops along a route.

speed.description: Metres a minute, stops and lights included.

service.description: When buses run, and every how many minutes: hours on the clock, the last not included.
